requester_gate_notice: Every request is read and approved by a named officer before any data is fetched. Nothing is fetched from upstream until that happens.
requester_intro_service_promise: A decision is made within 24 business hours. The extract is sent by email — it never appears on a page.
requester_no_reason_notice: If a request is not approved, you are told only that it was not approved — no reason is given. If you believe that was a mistake, call the number below and quote your reference number.
requester_deid_note: The same 23 columns for every request.
requester_deid_intro: A file with no names in it is the correct result, not a broken one.
requester_deid_will_get_list: One row per case; the report code, ICD-10 diagnosis and diagnosis list; birth date, age at onset, gender, prefix, nationality, occupation, marital status; province and district of registration, province and district at survey, and the health region of the survey province; the hospital code; onset, treatment, diagnosis, death, report and update dates.
requester_deid_will_not_get_list: Names, surnames, national ID; addresses, house numbers, roads, villages; sub-district (ตำบล) or finer, the district being the finest named geography; map coordinates; free text of any kind; any contact detail of a case.
requester_deid_closing: This allowlist is strict and not negotiable per request — a reviewer cannot widen it for you. A data dictionary explaining every column travels inside the extract.
requester_email_warning: The email address you give is where the extract link is sent, and nowhere else. It is never checked for typos — a mistyped address means the extract goes nowhere and you will not be told.
requester_retention_notice_kicker: What is kept, and for how long
requester_retention_notice: Your contact details and the record of this request are kept indefinitely, to keep every data release traceable to who asked and who approved it. You may ask by phone to have your contact details removed once this request is finished.
requester_span_cap_notice: Maximum span: 365 days. The DDC API enforces this cap — a wider range is refused, never split. If you need a longer history, send more than one request.
requester_date_range_error: Enter a valid, non-inverted date range.
requester_date_range_span_error: That is {days} days — more than the 365-day cap the DDC API enforces. Split it into more than one request instead.
requester_area_region_select_label: Health region (เขตสุขภาพ)
requester_region_vocabulary_note: เขตสุขภาพ is the Ministry of Public Health's health-region geography. It is not the same as a สคร. office's catchment area, even where the number matches.
requester_epidem_area_label: This filters on the province that investigated the case, not the province where the person lives or is registered — the address that answers "cases I investigated".
requester_area_error: Choose a valid province or health region, never both.
requester_contact_workplace_note: Free text — never checked against a list. It is what a reviewer weighs when deciding whether to approve this request.
requester_submit_generic_error: Something went wrong sending your request. Please try again.
requester_review_warning: Once submitted, a request cannot be edited by anyone — including a reviewer.
requester_review_tel_row_note: A reviewer may call this number before deciding.
requester_review_email_row_note: The extract link goes here, and nowhere else.
requester_confirmation_subheading: Your request is with a reviewer
requester_confirmation_service_promise: A decision is made within 24 business hours. Nothing further appears on this page.
requester_confirmation_telephone_line: Questions? Call {telephone} and quote your reference number.
requester_duplicate_heading: You already have a request in progress
requester_duplicate_body: A request from this connection is already {state}, submitted {submittedAt}. This one was not sent.
requester_duplicate_reassurance: Nothing is lost and nothing needs doing. Wait for that request to be decided.
